title: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
steps:
Cook rice, steam
broccoli. Whisk honey,
soy, garlic + vinegar

Sear the chops
4 min per side
to 145°F inside

Pour in the sauce,
simmer until sticky.
Slice, serve over rice
vo: Dinner in thirty minutes, and the sauce is the best part.
Tonight: honey garlic pork chops with rice.
You need boneless pork chops, honey, soy sauce, garlic, rice vinegar, jasmine rice, broccoli and green onions.
Cook the rice, steam the broccoli, and whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and rice vinegar.
Sear the pork chops four minutes per side, until they hit one forty-five inside.
Pour in the sauce, let it get sticky, then slice and serve over rice with the broccoli.
